title: Meggitt-Wagner Classification of Diabetic Foot Lesions Knowledge Object
description: This knowledge object classifies one diabetic foot lesion or assessment site, at one assessment event, as Wagner score 0-5. It specifies classification-not treatment, prognosis, amputation risk, or hyperbaric-oxygen eligibility.
